newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea buys 50,000T corn to aid N.Korea.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea buys 50,000T corn to aid N.Korea.

text.p: South Korea has bought 50,000 tonnes of corn at $151.80 a tonne, C&F, to aid famine-threatened North Korea, the state-run Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corp (AFMC) said on Monday.
An AFMC official said the corn was purchased at the weekend from The Korea Express Co Ltd.
The corn will be delivered by the end of August to the western North Korean port of Nampo, near Pyongyang, he said. Shipments would be made in lots of 5,000-10,000 tonnes.
Traders said the corn was bought from China in view of geographical proximity and the need to transport the grain quickly.
